summary: community.vmware vmware_guest_tools_info will drop vm_tools_install_status in 5.0.0 because VMware deprecated the API. Use vm_tools_running_status or vm_tools_version_status.
questions: What should I use instead of vm_tools_install_status?

answer_card.title: vm_tools_install_status removal
answer_card.answer_md: `vmware_guest_tools_info` will drop `vm_tools_install_status` in 5.0.0 because VMware deprecated the underlying API. Use `vm_tools_running_status` or `vm_tools_version_status`.
